LIVE LOCK-SCREEN DOODLE

Draw together.
Right from your
lock screen.

A wobbly heart. A silly face. A little hello that appears as you draw. Open a live session with your person and watch each other's strokes appear over your own wallpapers.

  1. Start a little moment.Tap Live doodle together in LockTied. Your person gets an invitation and chooses to join.
  2. Make it yours, together.With both canvases open and online, your strokes appear on both phones. Only strokes are shared; each phone keeps its own wallpaper behind them.
  3. Keep the good ones.Choose Keep as my wallpaper to save the shared drawing to your own lock screen. End for both finishes the session for you both.

A little shortcut to your person. Enable the optional lock-screen drawing shortcut in Settings, then use its notification to open the drawing screen while your phone stays locked, where Android allows it.

Both phones onlineUp to 4 minutes per session
What happens to my normal lock screen?

The dedicated drawing screen appears over your wallpaper. Android hides its normal lock-screen clock and notifications while you draw. It does not unlock your phone or change your wallpaper automatically; keeping the result is your choice. Notification access and whether Android asks you to unlock depend on your phone and security settings.

02 / FROM YOUR PHONE TO THEIRS

Two phones.
Three little steps.

For your partner, your best friend,
or someone who feels like home.

01

Find your person.

Install LockTied on both Android phones. Connect with a single-use pairing code or scan the QR code in the app.

02

Make a little something.

Choose a photo or take a new one. Add your words, draw a little detail, then preview it before sharing.

03

Brighten their screen.

They can apply your creation to their lock screen, or opt into automatic wallpaper updates in Settings.

Wallpaper cropping and automatic delivery depend on the phone, Android settings and internet connection.

03 / GOOD TO KNOW

The little
details.

Something else on your mind?
Get in touch ↗

Which phones does LockTied work on?

LockTied is an Android app for Android 8 or later, with Google Play services. Both phones need an internet connection to share. There is no iPhone version currently. Lock-screen behaviour and background delivery vary by phone and Android settings.

Is it available to download?

LockTied is currently in Google Play testing. The Play link below is for eligible testers; public availability has not yet been confirmed. A test build's features may differ from the previews on this page.

Can I choose what appears on my lock screen?

Yes. Apply received images yourself, or enable Automatic lock-screen wallpaper in Settings. You can save an image to your gallery too. Anyone looking at your lock screen can see its wallpaper, so share thoughtfully.

How many people can I connect with?

One person at a time. Connect with someone you know using an expiring invitation code or QR code. There is no public feed or people search. You can remove the paired phone in Settings.

Are there sharing limits?

Each pair shares an allowance of 300 sent wallpaper images and 20 live doodle sessions per UTC calendar month. Each live session lasts up to four minutes. Sent notes and static doodles count as images. Local previews and gallery saves do not count. Settings shows your pair's monthly usage.

How is shared content handled?

Sharing is restricted to your pair, and data is encrypted in transit. LockTied does not use end-to-end encryption; administrators with project access can access stored images. Read the privacy policy for details and the data deletion page for request instructions.

Where can I get help or report a concern?

Use Report a concern in the app's Settings or email Prioritydesk.app@outlook.com. See the sharing rules for guidance. Support and deletion requests are handled manually.
